text:
alex_park: OK team, chi1 cluster bootstrap finished a few mins ago. I'm starting the validation checklist now. pinging @mira for networking, @samir for GPU pools, and @jin for canary load. ops-bot will run the automated smoke suite.

ops-bot: automated-smoke: kicked off checks: [ssh, kube-apiserver, etcd, cni, ingress, node-readiness, gpu-health, nv_peer_check]. Running in parallel. Logs will appear below.

mira: quick note — VPC peering to core-net missing a route for 10.42.0.0/16. Saw traffic drop on chi1-ingress.

alex_park: thanks, mira. I just pushed the missing route (route-chi1-core) and re-applied the firewall tag. pls re-verify.

ops-bot: ssh check: OK
ops-bot: kube-apiserver: OK (3/3 masters healthy)
ops-bot: etcd: OK
ops-bot: cni: WARN (flannel: 2 pods CrashLoopBackOff)
ops-bot: ingress: OK
ops-bot: node-readiness: 11/12 ready
ops-bot: gpu-health: WARN (chi1-gpu-07: NVML error)

samir: on gpu-07 — seen this before after driver hotpatch. I'll cordon + drain then cycle the node. starting reprovision now.

mira: rechecked routes after alex's change — VPC peering route is present, ICMP to core-nat passes. flannel pods still crash on chi1-wrk-02. attaching kubelet logs: ```Mar 12 18:12:01 kubelet[1234]: E03012 kubelet failed to configure cni: plugin not found```

alex_park: devx-runner, can you run the CNI bootstrap script on chi1-wrk-02? It might have missed the post-provision hook.

devx-runner: running: ssh chi1-wrk-02 sudo /opt/devx/cni-bootstrap.sh && kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart daemonset/flannel

ops-bot: gpu reprovision started by samir on chi1-gpu-07
ops-bot: post-reprovision checks queued

ops-bot: cni bootstrap completed on chi1-wrk-02, flannel pods Restarted -> now 3/3 flannel healthy
ops-bot: node-readiness: 12/12 ready
ops-bot: gpu-health: chi1-gpu-07 now healthy (NVML OK)

jin: starting 30-min canary stress run using image redwood/canary:latest against model-serve route (replicas=20). target steady RPS 200, p95 SLA 250ms. will post metrics.

ops-bot: canary-started job id=canary-1775551234-1 replicas=20 target=200rps duration=30m

ops-bot: canary metrics (10m window): throughput 210rps, p50 40ms, p95 165ms, error-rate 0.7%

alex_park: p95 165ms < 250ms so SLO gate PASS. error-rate 0.7% under 1% threshold. Good. samir, any outstanding infra concerns?

samir: GPU pool autoscaler config validated: min=12, desired=24, max=48. Cost check: projected steady-state ~ $3.6k/day at current gpu-hour pricing. Recommend we set an alert if spend burn > 20% above estimate during first 48h.

mira: network check complete — BGP sessions stable, peering latencies within expected. No ACLs blocking telemetry.

ops-bot: final health scan: all checks green. list: roles: control-plane ok, nodes ok, csi ok, ingress ok, metrics ok, gpu pool ok.

alex_park: doc update: chi1 bootstrap runbook updated with these fixes and the missing route step. handing off to oncall for first 24h monitoring. @samir can you create the cost alert? @jin please add the canary results to the post-mortem style readiness doc. :thumbsup:

samir: creating cost burn alert -> yar alarm created (policy id: burn-chi1-177555).

jin: added canary metrics + graphs to runbook page.

alex_park: sign-off from infra: READY_FOR_HANDOFF

mira: sign-off from network: READY

samir: sign-off from compute: READY

ops-bot: note: schedule a 1-hour follow-up check at +6h to verify autoscaler behavior under production-ish load.

alex_park: copy that. I'll post the handoff message to #oncall and include links to logs and runbook. great job team.
